name: Thaw
subtitle: Welcome to Terminus. Every life here is a water clock.
signs: Move with the arrow keys or A / D.
Jump with Space. Hold it longer to jump higher.
Your life is the water clock, top left. It never stops dripping.
Sulfur crystals are the only wealth on Terminus. Each one buys you time.
Burning sulfur pits are instant death.
Standing still costs time too. Keep moving.
Doorways lead on, across the islands.
